purpose: Teach: 丞/濱/荒野/北西/南海/会津/準々/ペニス

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、古文書の丞、つまり「丞」職の解読を、警察、専門家に依頼されますね
lines.en: So in this case, you'd be calling in police and specialists to decipher the old court documents—the "jou" position specifically?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pacing. Slight lift at the end like he's offering a quiet observation, not a question. Respectful distance in his tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「濱」、つまり浜地区の盗難事案も対応されますね
lines.en: And the police would handle the theft case in the old Hama district—the one with the archaic character?
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. Nods in his voice. Professional but warm, showing he's following the logic. Slight emphasis on confirmation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、荒野、つまり原野での失踪事案を、警察、捜索されますね
lines.en: So with this incident—the missing person in the wilderness—the police would coordinate the search operation?
lines.style: Hesitant, careful phrasing. Like he's thinking through each detail as he speaks. Slight upturn at the end, checking himself for understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、北西気象、つまり北西強風時の救助も対応されますね
lines.en: And during northwestern gales, the police would also coordinate rescue efforts in those conditions?
lines.style: Clear, professional affirmation. Measured cadence. A slight nod in his voice—showing he grasps the scope of the operation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、南海地域、つまり南海地震の津波警戒を、警察、連携されますね
lines.en: In this case, with the South Sea region—the tsunami warning for the Nankai earthquake—the police would coordinate with other agencies?
lines.style: Deliberate, respectful pacing. Slight pause before key terms. His voice carries the weight of understanding the scale of the situation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、会津地方の歴史的事件も把握されてますね
lines.en: And the police are familiar with the historical incidents in the Aizu region as well?
lines.style: Steady, almost conversational. A light affirmation. Like he's piecing together the breadth of the department's knowledge.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、スポーツ大会の準々決勝中の盗難事件を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So in this case—the theft during the sports tournament quarterfinals—the police investigated that incident?
lines.style: Careful, methodical tone. Light emphasis on the specific event. A touch of curiosity in his delivery, like he's testing his understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、医療現場でのペニス露出、つまり公然わいせつ事件にも対応されますね
lines.en: And the police also handle cases of indecent exposure in medical facilities—public lewdness incidents?
lines.style: Professional, factual delivery. No hesitation. Direct eye contact in the voice. Stating a reality without judgment.
